First chapter / 第一章

This is a long paragraph for testing soft wrapping without changing the underlying text. Reading widths should change only the window margins, leaving words, links, and saved character positions intact. The same book can be shown in narrow and wide windows, and neither display should require hard line breaks to be inserted into the paragraph.

中文阅读应当保留自然的标点和段落。窗口宽度改变时，正文可以自动换行，阅读位置和书签不应该改变。English and 中文 can share the same paragraph without changing the terminal's font configuration.

Publisher-colored text should use the reader's theme.
